bootstrap.label: project foundation
bootstrap.statement: Live to eat. Save every place worth returning to.
bootstrap.title: The foundation is ready
bootstrap.body: The mobile app, share web, and domain boundaries are in place before product work begins.
bootstrap.footnote: Maps, Places, and sign-in remain unverified until they run with real keys and accounts.

discover.title: Discover
discover.subtitle: Browse only places people chose to share, then save the ones you want as your own private record.
discover.publicMapBody: Only places you mark public appear in other people’s discovery.
discover.loadError: We could not load public maps. Check the connection and try again.
discover.publicMapError: This public map is unavailable right now. Its visibility may have changed.

discover.unavailablePlaces: {{count}} places cannot be checked right now.
discover.partialPlaces: Showing the most recent {{count}} of {{total}} places first.

auth.launchBody: Loading your map and saved places securely.
auth.loadingBody: Keeping your saved places private while we restore your session.
auth.configurationBody: Add the development project URL and publishable key, then configure Google and Apple providers plus the app callback in Supabase. No secret belongs in this app.
auth.signInBody: Sign in to save your private places, then choose the profile you want other people to see.
auth.emailSignInBody: Pick up where you left off with your saved places and private notes.
auth.signUpTitle: Start a map of your own taste.
auth.signUpBody: Create an account, then choose the name and map settings you want other people to see.
auth.forgotPasswordTitle: Find your way back to your map.
auth.forgotPasswordBody: Enter the email you used to sign up and we will send a link for choosing a new password.
auth.resetSentBody: We requested a password reset link for {{email}}.
auth.resetSentPrivacy: If an account uses that address, the email will arrive. Check spam or try again later if you do not see it.
auth.newPasswordBody: Your saved places and private notes stay as they are. Only your password changes.
auth.cancelRecovery: Cancel and return to sign in
auth.passwordUpdatedBody: We closed the recovery session. Sign in again with your new password.
auth.orContinue: or continue with a social account
auth.privateByDefault: New saved places and notes are private by default.
auth.configurationInline: Connect a Supabase development project to use this form with a real account.
auth.confirmationBody: We sent a confirmation email to {{email}}. Confirm it, then return to sign in.
auth.accountRecoveryBody: Matching emails are never merged automatically. If you used another provider before, sign in with it first and use account recovery or linking once it is verified.
auth.onboardingBody: Your Google or Apple name is not copied here. Start with the name and handle you want for LiveToEat.
auth.onboardingPrivacyTitle: Start with a map that's yours.
auth.onboardingPrivacyBody: Review the defaults for saving and sharing, then choose the language you want to use.
auth.onboardingPrivateBody: Places, personal notes, and visit history start private.
auth.onboardingSharingBody: You confirm the places and region every time you create a share.
auth.handleHint: 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. This cannot be changed in this first version.
auth.consent: I confirm that I meet the age requirement and accept the Terms and Privacy Notice.
auth.legalNote: The document versions and time of consent are recorded to protect your account.
auth.blockedBody: This account cannot open a map right now. Use the support and recovery path configured for this product.
auth.connectionTitle: We could not restore your account
auth.connectionBody: Check the connection and try again. Your session details are not shown here.

errors.AUTH_LINK_INVALID: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Sign in or request another email.
errors.CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED: Sign-in setup is incomplete for this development build.
errors.EMAIL_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: We cannot send an email to this address right now. Try again later.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Confirm your account from the email we sent before signing in.
errors.EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: Too many confirmation emails were requested. Try again in a little while.
errors.HANDLE_TAKEN: That handle is already in use. Try another one.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: Enter an email address you can use.
errors.INVALID_ONBOARDING_INPUT: Check your name, handle, and confirmation, then try again.
errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a new password that is different from your previous one.
errors.REQUEST_FAILED: That did not complete. Please try again.
errors.USER_ALREADY_REGISTERED: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.

formErrors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
formErrors.passwordTooShort: Your password must be at least 8 characters.

Good people.
Great places.

explore.maps: Maps with a point of view
explore.emptyHint: Try a different region or name.
explore.privacy: Only public places appear here. Personal records stay private.
explore.sampleNote: A lovely place for a slow meal. (Sample description)
explore.copyHint: Saved as private and want to go. Their notes and visit history aren’t copied.
explore.blockHint: Hide this person’s maps in this demo. You can unblock them from your profile.

sharing.draftHint: A draft on this device · Nothing is published
sharing.regionHint: Choose places within your selected region, including its smaller areas.
sharing.snapshotHint: Only your current selection is included. Future saves won’t be added. Choose up to 200 places.
sharing.emptyHint: Go back and choose another region.
sharing.name: Share title
sharing.privateHint: Personal notes, tags, visits and folder names are excluded.
sharing.consent: I agree to change {{count}} private places to unlisted. In demo mode, this only changes data on this device.
sharing.forwardHint: Real share links can be forwarded. You can’t retract screenshots or someone’s independent saves.
sharing.connectionRequired: Link creation requires the connected service. Nothing is shared externally.
sharing.created: Share draft saved on this device
sharing.noSharesHint: Choose an area and places, then preview what others would see.

profile.title: Profile
profile.demo: Demo profile · Only on this device
profile.publicHint: Only your {{count}} public places can appear. Personal notes are always private.
profile.languageHint: Choose your app language. Place names and your own notes stay as written.
profile.exportHint: Export your visits, favorites, tags and folders. Provider place names, addresses and coordinates are excluded.
profile.exportPartial: Exports only the {{count}} of {{total}} currently loaded places. A full account export requires the connected service.
profile.notesWarning: Anyone receiving this file can read your personal notes.
profile.exported: Your file is ready. Check your downloads or share sheet.
profile.privacyBody: Your notes, tags, visits and folders stay private. Use the separate public description for anything you want others to see.
profile.sharingBody: Turning off your public map doesn’t revoke separate share links. Making a place private or deleting it removes it from existing shares. Making it public later won’t restore it to old shares.
profile.locationBody: Choose a region and search for places without allowing access to your location.
profile.demoPrivacy: Demo records are stored only on this device. They aren’t synced to an account or published to public maps or share links.
profile.blockedHint: Blocked people’s sample maps are hidden from Explore.
profile.helpBody: Try adding a city or country to the place name. Check the branch and address before saving.
profile.accountBody: Try the sign-in method you originally used. Linking, recovering or deleting an account requires identity verification.
profile.supportNotConnected: Support submission and real account deletion are not connected in this build. A support channel is required before release.
profile.aboutBody: A food map discovered through people. Keep a record of your taste and inspire someone’s next meal.
profile.artwork: Food and map illustrations were created for LiveToEat. They are not photographs or geographic data of actual places.
profile.signoutHint: Sign out on this device. Your account’s saved records will remain.
profile.editHint: Choose the name and bio you want to show. Your sign-in account’s details aren’t copied automatically.
profile.publicHint_one: Only your {{count}} public place can appear. Personal notes are always private.
profile.publicHint_other: Only your {{count}} public places can appear. Personal notes are always private.
